title: Malmgren at the IDA, interviewed by the host

tellings.quote: you know, just sticking with Walker for a second, Walker was chairman of the Institute for Defense Analysis, the IDA, and Malmrren was a part of the IDA early on as well, and I had the privilege of interviewing Malgrren.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says that Eric Walker was chairman of the Institute for Defense Analyses, a US research group that advises the military, and that a man named Malmgren was part of that institute early on. Michels says he had the chance to interview Malmgren himself. He raises it to tie these figures to the story of a secret government UFO program.
